marta: Quick brainstorm 1: we need a benchmark story that feels actionable for PMs. Idea: "tilt-to-frontier" mapping — show where products land given SLA and cost targets. Need hero + two small panels + routing rules. Draft deck Fri.

sam: Like that. Makes it product-focused: "where should your product sit on the tilt-to-frontier map?" short hook.

liv: Visual plan: hero scatter with shaded tilt band + convex hull, small violin for p95 spread, tiny stacked bar for per-token breakouts. I'll do dark/light theme variants.

alex: Will run microbench for chat (128/256) and embeddings (1k) across hosted/dedicated/int8. Will include median, p95, cost/1k, tokens/sec. Posting CSV link when done.

noah: Routing rules draft: bench-request -> tag "bench". If ARR > 50k -> AE. If selects "private" or "VPC" -> Enterprise + security review. If "dedicated" requested or qps>5k -> Solutions Eng.

bench-bot: Bench run complete: dataset "microchat-2026-07". Results (median / p95 / $ per 1k / tps per GPU): hosted 138 / 430 / $0.145 / 7.2k; dedicated 49 / 120 / $0.073 / 30.5k; int8-quant 70 / 185 / $0.047 / 24k. CSV: /bench/microchat-2026-07/summary.csv

liv: Nice. Can you also add percent p95 improvement columns (hosted->dedicated, hosted->int8)? tiny labels help the inset.

alex: Added percent_delta columns. hosted->dedicated p95 ~72%, hosted->int8 ~57%. CSV link updated.

sam: Webinar flow: 1) problem (product tradeoffs), 2) tilt-to-frontier demo (live microbench and interpret), 3) levers: routing, quantization, caching, 4) quick customer vignette + CTA to run a free micro-bench. 20m + Qs.

marta: Love it. Small code snippet for the hero (feel free to reuse):
```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.spatial import ConvexHull

df = pd.read_csv('bench_summary.csv')
plt.scatter(df['median_ms'], df['cost_per_1k'])
pts = df[['median_ms','cost_per_1k']].values
hull = ConvexHull(pts)
plt.plot(pts[hull.vertices,0], pts[hull.vertices,1], '--', color='gray')
plt.xscale('log')
plt.xlabel('Median latency (ms)'); plt.ylabel('Cost per 1k tokens ($)')
plt.title('Tilt-to-frontier: where latency meets economics')
plt.savefig('tilt_frontier_hero.png', dpi=150)
```
